headword: キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい}
reading: きゃっしゅれすけっさい

definitions.gloss: cashless payment; non-cash payment; electronic payment
definitions.explanation: Any form of payment that does not involve physical cash — including credit cards, debit cards, electronic money (Suica, PayPay, etc.), QR code payments, and other digital payment methods.

notes:
A compound of the English loanword ⟦キャッシュレス→キャッシュレス：06096_kyasshuresu⟧ (cashless) and the Japanese word ⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧ (payment, settlement). The term has become extremely common in Japan since the late 2010s as the government promoted digital payment adoption.

Japan was historically a cash-heavy society, but キャッシュレス{決済|けっさい} has spread rapidly through services like PayPay, Suica/PASMO, LINE Pay, and d-⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧. Many stores now display signs indicating which cashless methods they accept.
